content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkStartOfReception callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_ <CGI> call is returned unchanged from the Rte_COMCbkStartOfReception call- back.
